nodes.summary: Let $N$ and $r$ be natural numbers. If it is not the case that every prime dividing $\binom{N}{r}$ is at most $r$, then some prime $p$ with $r < p$ divides $\binom{N}{r}$.
nodes.title: Negating the no-large-prime condition for $\binom{N}{r}$

nodes.summary: Let $N$, $r$ and $U$ be natural numbers, and let $m = \max(N + 1 - r, 0)$. Suppose that $\binom{N}{r} \le U$ whenever every prime dividing $\binom{N}{r}$ is at most $r$, and that $U < m^r / r!$ as rational numbers. Then some prime $p$ with $r < p$ divides $\binom{N}{r}$.
nodes.title: A prime divisor of $\binom{N}{r}$ above $r$ from an upper bound below the lower bound

nodes.summary: For every natural number $r$, the number $\pi(r)$ of primes $p \le r$ satisfies $\pi(r) \le \lfloor r/2 \rfloor + 1$.
nodes.title: At most $\lfloor r/2 \rfloor + 1$ primes up to $r$

nodes.summary: For every natural number $r \ge 2$, the number $\pi(r)$ of primes $p \le r$ satisfies $\pi(r) \le r - 1$, since all such primes lie in $\{2, \dots, r\}$.
nodes.title: At most $r - 1$ primes up to $r$

nodes.summary: For every natural number $r \ge 38$, the number $\pi(r)$ of primes $p \le r$ satisfies $\pi(r) \le \lfloor 3r/8 \rfloor$.
nodes.title: Erdős's $3r/8$ prime-counting bound

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
